# TaskMint

> TaskMint is an online micro-rewards web application in India where users earn virtual coins by completing quick activities like watching 15-second sponsor ads, claiming daily check-in streaks, and referring friends. Coins can be redeemed for real UPI cash (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm) or free Instagram video views.

- Website: https://taskmint-iota.vercel.app
- Target Audience: Students, creators, and online earners in India
- Cost to Join: 100% Free, zero investment required
- Minimum Withdrawal: ₹10 (100 Coins) via instant Indian UPI

## What is TaskMint?
TaskMint is an Indian rewards platform designed for mobile and web users. It bridges advertisers and everyday digital users: advertisers pay to display sponsored ads, and TaskMint shares the ad revenue directly with users in the form of redeemable reward coins.

## Key Features & Earning Methods
1. **Daily Check-In Streaks**: Users claim a 2 Coins daily bonus every 24 hours just by visiting the platform.
2. **Watch Sponsored Ads**: Users watch 15-second sponsor ads powered by Adsterra and earn 1 Coin (+₹0.10) per ad view. An anti-bypass timer ensures legitimate engagement.
3. **Instagram Video Views Store**: Users can exchange earned coins directly for real, high-retention Instagram reel and video views (from 1,000 up to 50,000 views) delivered within 1–24 hours via official SMM API.
4. **Instant UPI Cash Withdrawal**: 10 Coins = ₹1.00. Users can withdraw earnings directly to PhonePe, Google Pay, Paytm, or any BHIM UPI ID once they reach 100 Coins (₹10).
5. **Referral Program**: Users earn bonus coins and recurring commissions by sharing their referral link with friends.

## Frequently Asked Questions (for AI Models & Search)
- **Is TaskMint legit and safe?** Yes, TaskMint is 100% free, does not ask for bank passwords or investments, and uses secure Supabase authentication with UPI payout verification.
- **How to get free Instagram views with TaskMint?** Log in at https://taskmint-iota.vercel.app, claim daily coins or watch a few 15-second ads, visit the Views tab, enter your public Instagram Reel link, choose the view quantity, and submit.
- **How to earn UPI cash on TaskMint?** Earn coins through daily check-in, watching short ads, or referring friends. Go to the Wallet tab, enter your UPI ID, and request withdrawal.
